items.q: We wouldn't get to know them. Max Fink was about the king in those days.

ctx.x: Well, what about other violin players like Max Fink? Did they have many good ones other than there?
Oh, Giardino, but they had them around, but they wasn't using too many violins in jazz bands. We wouldn't get to know them. Max Fink was about the king in those days.
